data.description: At OP | Lower Floor | Versace Finishes
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 2-bedroom apartment in One Sky Park Tower B by IMAN Developers, offered at the Original Price (OP). This is a rare opportunity to secure a premium residence at launch price in one of Dubai's most distinctive luxury & sold-out developments.

Situated on a lower floor, this beautifully designed apartment features a spacious open-plan layout, floor-to-ceiling windows, and elegant interiors finished with Versace Ceramics bringing timeless Italian craftsmanship and luxury into every living space. The residence offers generous living and dining areas, a contemporary kitchen, premium fittings, and thoughtfully designed bedrooms, making it ideal for both end-users and investors.

One Sky Park is an architectural landmark that combines luxury living with an exceptional lifestyle. Residents enjoy a curated collection of resort-style amenities designed for wellness, recreation, and relaxation, setting a new benchmark for upscale living in Dubai.

Property Features:

* 2-Bedroom Apartment
* Offered at Original Price (OP)
* Lower Floor
* Versace Ceramics Flooring & Finishes
* Spacious Open-Plan Layout
* Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
* Premium Kitchen & Bathroom Fittings
* Smart Home Technology
* Infinity Swimming Pools
* State-of-the-Art Fitness Centre
* Private Jacuzzi & Wellness Areas
* Padel Court & Sports Facilities
* Jogging Track
* Landscaped Sky Gardens
* Children's Play Area
* Clubhouse & Residents' Lounge
* 24/7 Security & Concierge
* Prime Investment Opportunity
